name: Fiviune
description: Fiviune was a world that was located in the Grumani sector, in the Outer Rim Territories. It was considered to be a dead world and its surface consisted of rocky plates and spiky crags. However, there were rumors that Fiviune had once been ruled by an ancient civilization, which had been destroyed.
